content: {"episode_id":"ep-05013","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The claim for CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, was denied under CO-197 for lack of precertification or authorization prior to the service date. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring. Given the clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period."}
